name: Pane
text: Pane: Hold—why fork the repo instead of working directly in `facet-viz/core`? Forking risks divergence from upstream updates and complicates merge conflicts later. Before spinning up `npm run dev`, verify the current build’s accessibility score with axe-core or Lighthouse—console errors alone don’t guarantee WCAG compliance. What’s the plan if the dashboard fails basic screen-reader navigation?
